scientific_integrity: All-parameter classification via explicit optima and pairwise intersection, with two reproducible finite cross-checks. No claim of external certification or publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Assumes two bipartition sizes at least three; only globally maximum induced matchings are configurations and only simultaneous arbitrary edge replacements are moves; the general proof is symbolic and finite computational checks are corroboration; equivalent unindexed literature is a residual risk.
title: Two sharp batch-exchange thresholds for induced matchings in bipartite subdivisions
